design_concept: Expressive Minimalism with a 'Phygital' and vibrant local feel. A modern Bento-grid approach that handles high data density but avoids the sterile 'SaaS' look.

colors.rules: Never use pure #000000 or #FFFFFF without context. Use Tinted Greys.

rules: Use Cabinet Grotesk for all Headings (H1-H4) with tight tracking.
Use Plus Jakarta Sans for Body and UI elements.
Never use Inter or generic sans for headings.
H1 Maximum size: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl. DO NOT use text-7xl+.

layouts.hero_section: Asymmetrical Bento Grid. Left column spans 2/3 for dynamic search/banner, right column stacked for quick categories.
layouts.category_grid: Dense 'Tetris' grid mixing square and tall rectangular cards for products vs services.
layouts.store_profile: Full-width hero banner with 'Crystal Glass' floating header.
layouts.dashboards: Strict high-density grid. Cardless UI with subtle 1px borders. Max radius 8px.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Crystal Glass' (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or bg-black/60) for sticky navigation.
visual_enhancers.borders: Visible grid borders for data-heavy sections (border-collapse look).
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (grain) on dark mode backgrounds to add tactile feel.

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary actions. Sharp (rounded-md) for dense dashboard actions.
component_guidelines.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, hover triggers slight lift.
component_guidelines.forms: Use Shadcn customized components (adapted for .js). Input fields should have generous padding.
component_guidelines.navigation: Sticky glass header. MUST have visible navigation on desktop.
component_guidelines.overlays: CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or dropdowns. Must have solid or blurred background.

motion.hover: Explicitly set text color on hover (e.g. hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for marketplace item grids.
motion.micro_interactions: Heart icon (wishlist) must scale up and pop color on click.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images uses max bg-black/50 or text-shadow.
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2 on all inputs.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='checkout-button').

image_urls.description: Vibrant indoor market scene with fresh vegetables
Colorful street vendor stall at night market

media.image_rules: Never use pure transparent overlays on hero images. Mobile image max-height 80vh. Use provided Unsplash/Pexels URLs. Do not use placeholder images.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use Framer Motion for simple spatial transitions. Avoid heavy WebGL unless for a specific interactive store map.

GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Adopt 'Expressive Minimalism' combining structural clarity with emotional aesthetics (high energy, dopamine design via accents).
Implement 'Phygital' integration vibes by ensuring mobile-first spatial experiences.
Use generous spacing: 2-3x more spacing than standard designs. Containers with borders must have internal padding.
Optical alignment over geometrical alignment (e.g. buttons with icons).
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Use solid dark colors.
Never apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific property transitions.
Never center align the main .App container in CSS.
DO NOT use emojis as icons. Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react.
Do not use generic 'card' wrappers everywhere. Build cardless/grid-based layouts for dashboards.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
instructions_to_main_agent: Build using React (.js/.jsx) + Tailwind CSS + Shadcn UI.
Start by setting up the dark/light mode toggle.
Implement the Layout container with sticky navigation (Glassmorphism, NO purely transparent backgrounds).
For the marketplace front page, use a Bento Grid layout.
For dashboard routes (Customer/Owner/Admin), use a tight density (gap-4) Sidebar layout.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for creative marketing sections, and Shadcn for complex interactives (Forms, Modals).
Integrate multilingual (ID/EN) and multi-currency (IDR/USD) toggles visually in the top header.
Include couriers visually (JNE, J&T, SiCepat, POS Indonesia, AnterAja, Ninja Xpress, TIKI, Lion Parcel) in checkout.
